members.summary: Do not ship: MCP safety and latency contracts fail; evidence is incomplete.

findings.title: The release-blocking amd64 prerequisite has no evidence
findings.body: The table omits the required amd64 template scaffold-build-smoke evidence.
findings.code: ## 실행한 명령과 결과 (전부 이 HEAD에서 실측, exit code)
findings.recommendation: Record the template commit and passing amd64 build-smoke evidence.

findings.title: Mutation calls can block the whole MCP server for 20 minutes
findings.body: This sync call uses mutation.ts:47's 20-minute default before wait=false returns.
findings.recommendation: Return a handle quickly; keep list/status responsive during stalled runs.

findings.title: Malformed explicit paths fall back to the server working directory
findings.body: null paths pass this check, become undefined, and invoke process.cwd().
findings.recommendation: Runtime-validate schemas; require absolute paths and no MCP fallback.

findings.title: URL tools can write plaintext credentials into the server checkout
findings.body: envDir is optional, so live URL calls write credentials in the server cwd.
findings.recommendation: Require envDir on both tools and test a live write from another cwd.

findings.title: Two advertised tools escape the shared result contract
findings.body: db_url and cache_url return text, so agents cannot use the shared Envelope.
findings.recommendation: Add URL verbs to the schema and return envelopes for success and failure.

members.summary: Do not ship: MCP can mutate the wrong cwd and block its own progress API.

findings.title: Schema-invalid arguments reach mutating operations
findings.body: null parentDir passes the check and falls back to the MCP server cwd.
findings.recommendation: Validate every inputSchema and return -32602 before tool.call.

findings.title: Credential URL tools infer an unsafe destination
findings.body: Omitted envDir can write connection secrets in the MCP server cwd.
findings.recommendation: Require non-empty envDir for both URL tools and test the actual write path.

findings.title: Synchronous calls defeat the bounded progress contract
findings.body: wait:false may poll 20 minutes; sync tool.call blocks status and later requests.
findings.recommendation: Return a run handle promptly; make calls async and test overlapping requests.
